description: Every fund matching some filters, each with its net assets and the source and date that number came from. Filters: desk, issuer, max_fee_pct, min_assets_usd; and, from the ETFIQ screener, tracks (the index the funds track, such as "S&P 500"), min_yield_pct (12-month yield of at least that percent), pays (payout frequency: weekly, monthly, quarterly, semiannual or annual, published for income ETFs) and sort (assets, largest first; fee, lowest first; yield, highest first). count is the whole matching set: when fewer rows come back, truncated and note say so, so the rows are part of the set, not all of it. first names every fund tied at the top of the order. Use for "find me all X" and "cheapest X" questions rather than repeated searches. Fees are percentages, not basis points. Funds with no published data for a filter are set aside and counted, not treated as failing it.

desk.description: Optional: only funds on this desk.

issuer.description: Optional: the issuer, matched exactly, case-insensitive, such as Vanguard.

limit.description: Most rows to return. Default 25; at most 200 when tracks, min_yield_pct, pays or sort is used.

max_fee_pct.description: Optional: the highest expense ratio, in percent (0.25 is 0.25%).

min_assets_usd.description: Optional: the smallest net assets, in US dollars.

min_yield_pct.description: 12-month yield of at least this many percent (10 is 10%).

pays.description: Payout frequency, published for income ETFs.

sort.description: assets: largest first; fee: lowest first; yield: highest first.

tracks.description: The index the funds track, such as S&P 500.

name: etf_screen

as_of.description: Date of the newest number in the answer.

citation.description: A ready citation string with the as-of date and the page address.

data.description: The answer, or null when ETFIQ refuses (then error and reason say why).

disclaimer_required.description: True when the answer carries numbers that need the not-advice line.

error.description: Present only on a refusal: what ETFIQ does not publish.

provenance.description: Where each number came from: field, source, as_of, source_uri.

reason.description: Present only on a refusal: why, and what to change.

tried.description: Present only on a refusal: what was looked up.

warnings.description: Caveats to show with the answer.
